issues.desc: CHK-001 and CHK-002 userSees unconditionally promise gap_analyze stops listing the row, but each context permits a legitimate "stop and record a real finding" branch in which the gap correctly persists. Make the success criterion cover both terminal states (gap mapped/removed OR a real finding recorded) so the item stays verifiable whichever branch occurs and the checklist cannot be forced green by annotating over a real gap.
